About this item

  • 1 DOSE WEEKLY FOR 4 WEEKS: Flush 32oz of the Microbe-Lift septic system restorer down your toilet every week for 4 weeks. In even the most extreme cases, it will typically take 90 days for the bacteria to work its way out to the drainfield. After 90 days, use the Microbe-Lift septic system maintainer every 3 months to maintain a healthy and happy bacteria colony.
  • QUALITY INGREDIENTS AND ENVIRONMENTALLY SAFE: The Microbe-Lift System Restore contains a special blend of our highly specialized microbial cultures. Healthy bacteria colonies are essential for the proper operation and maintenance of residential septic systems. That means our septic treatment is all-natural, contains zero chemicals, is non-toxic, non-pathogenic, and groundwater safe!
  • WORKS FOR RESIDENTIAL TANKS UP TO 2,500 GALLONS - The Microbe-Lift septic tank system restore effectively digests grease, fats, oils, and tissues which will improve your septic system performance and reduce you septic system and tank odors!
  • MADE IN THE USA SINCE 1976: The Microbe-Lift septic tank treatment has been keeping customers happy and saving them thousands on costly septic repairs for over 45+ years!!

Product description

AVOID A SEPTIC DISASTER – KEEP YOUR HOUSE UNCLOGGED

Guaranteed to Digest Grease, Fats, Oils and Tissues • Improves System Performance THE FRIENDLY SEPTIC TANK AND LEACH FIELD TREATMENT FOR YOUR HOME

All Natural Septic System Restoration

Completely non-toxic. With MICROBE-LIFT Flush N’ Go System Restore, you can maintain your entire residential septic tank system with a restorative dose of our special septic system improvement blend. The special blend contains digesting bacteria, humates, and enzymes, a restoration treatment for troubled septic systems.

Septic System Care

MICROBE-LIFT’s 100% fully matured anaerobic bacteria goes to work in situations where there is no air present (your septic system). Inside the septic tank, solid waste settles and is eaten by the anaerobic bacteria. Liquid waste floats to the top.

The Safe, Friendly Choice

MICROBE-LIFT Flush N’ Go System Restore contains biological friendly bacteria to assist overall septic system care. It is safe for people, animals, and plant life, Non-Toxic, Non-Pathogenic & Non-CAUSTIC. It’s 100% safe to groundwater.

Easy-to-use, Flush N’ Go Restoring Blend

TO USE: Flush one quart or approximately 32 oz. of Flush N’ Go System Restore down your toilet. Repeat once a week for the next three weeks. In most cases, it takes 90 days for the bacteria to work its way out to the drainfield.

Non-Toxic + All-Natural Ingredients

MICROBE-LIFT Flush N’ Go System Restore incorporates the action of stable, highly active microbes specifically selected for breaking down sludge, tissue, and grease in septic tank systems with safe, all-natural ingredients and NO damaging chemicals.

Benefits Entire Septic Tank System

RESIDENTIAL SEPTIC TANKS UP TO 2,500 Gallons!

MICROBE-LIFT Flush N’ Go System Restore for Septic System Care liquid blend comes in a convenient 1-gallon container. For best results, use MICROBE-LIFT Flush N’ Go System Restore for troubled septic systems. For regular septic system care, start with FLUSH N’ GO System Shock Treatment and follow up with FLUSH N’ GO System Maintainer Packets or FLUSH N’ GO System Maintainer Powder. Proudly MADE IN THE USA.

THE FINEST SEPTIC TANK PRODUCT...PERIOD!

. 100% safe to groundwater

. Effectively digests grease, fats, oils and tissues

. Improves system performance

. Reduces septic system and tank odors

    • Dr. X
      5.0 out of 5 stars Preventive Treatment
      Reviewed in the United States on July 5, 2023
      Style: Original Septic System & Cesspool TreatmentSize: 128 Fl OzVerified Purchase
      My septic tank has worked well for a long time. It is pumped about every 8 years. I use an enzyme treatment, including this one, once a year during summer when the biological activity is higher. I also use monthly tablets of bacteria. The enzymes can speed up the work of the bacteria by making more readily decomposeable organic matter. Whether this product is better than the competitors, I can't say, but they do appear to work. Even if they don't save you money from more frequent pumping, they are better for the overall system. The septic tank is a source of nutrients to nearby trees and plants around the house. Less pumping means richer soils. Septic systems do not use any energy we need to supply by electricity. When the septic tank is pumped, the contents go to treatment facilities that do use electrical energy. The nutrients that remain after treatment go to the rivers and are more widely distributed, supporting plant life along the path of the water.

      5.0 out of 5 stars Stopped the smell and no more standing water
      Reviewed in the United States on August 3, 2016
      Style: Original Septic System & Cesspool TreatmentSize: 32 Fl OzVerified Purchase
      Started seeing effluent on the surface near the riser and manhole cover. Limited flushes (only the toilet goes into septic, only septic TP and only human waste goes in), requested our young boys pee outside and poured every septic product into potty. Nothing helped and there was always water leaking out. An EPA nightmare.

      Knew we had failed lines as they were put in by my husband's dad in 1977 (hubby remembers his dad digging the trenches and laying the lateral lines which are terra cotta and the holding tank is made of asphault). Very old system! I met the hubby and moved in to the old home in 2005. Didn't know we had septic until 2014 (when it was pumped and septic guy said, "I'm shocked you haven't had more problems"). That was the beginning of our troubles.

      Conducted a ton of research (I now know so much about septic tanks, I feel that I have a backup career) and came across this product. Reviews on Amazon were stellar. Ordered 2 containers and poured them in. Oh man, does this stuff stink! Per the directions, pour 2 batches in and then follow up with 2 more the next week then 1 every other week for 4 weeks. I'm on application #3. Will be putting another treatment in this weekend. I plan on adding more than recommended because I know I have an old system and it needs help.

      Since starting the treatment, there has been no surfacing effluent, the smell around the manhole cover is gone and the dirt that used to be consistently wet is drying. I don't feel comfortable yet to resume flushing after just tinkle. Hoping that time and more treatments will get me to that spot. For now, this will be the only septic product I purchase.

      Would highly recommend to anyone who has a healthy or failing septic. $15.00/ dose is a small investment for your precious septic.

      ******************************************Update 10-4-2016************************************

      Still no sign of surface effluent or stink. If it weren't for the rain, would be bone dry. So very happy with this product! Adding 2 more containers this weekend to keep the good bacteria going.
